name: claude-mod-pack
description: Claude Mod Pack: small Claude Code mods. A status band with usage limits and a mod switcher, a button that hides every mod, a guard that keeps your name out of public pushes, and OpenAI Codex as native subagents.

plugins.name: status-band
plugins.description: Claude Status Band: usage limits with a pace that learns your hours, spend, context, last turn and tasks above the prompt, Compact and Handoff buttons, and a /mods panel to switch mods on or off.

plugins.name: claude-mod-hider
plugins.description: Claude Mod Hider: one tiny button that hides or shows every Claude Code mod above the prompt.

plugins.name: codex-bridge
plugins.description: Claude Codex Bridge: OpenAI Codex models as native Claude Code subagents, with the same task rows, timers, token counts and follow-ups.

plugins.name: push-guard
plugins.description: Claude Push Guard: stops a git push Claude runs when the commits would publish your name, email, home folder path or other words you list, and says exactly where they are.
